## 正文

**AnvilLib 为 Minecraft 模组开发者提供一系列实用的工具和框架** —— 由 Anvil Dev 开发的 NeoForge 模组库。

- 开发文档：https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/index.html
- 社区活动：https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/event/index.html
- GitHub：https://github.com/Anvil-Dev/AnvilLib
- MC百科：https://www.mcmod.cn/class/25475.html
- CurseForge：https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/anvil-lib
- Modrinth：https://modrinth.com/mod/anvil-lib

## 首页列出的模块（文档路径 /posts/docs/<模块>/）

| 模块 | 首页描述 | 文档 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Config | 基于注解的配置系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/config/index.html |
| Codec | 数据编解码与网络序列化工具 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/codec/index.html |
| Integration | 模组兼容性集成框架 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/integration/index.html |
| Network | 网络通信与数据包自动注册框架 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/network/index.html |
| Recipe | 世界内配方系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/recipe/index.html |
| Moveable Entity Block | 可被活塞推动的方块实体支持 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/moveable-entity-block/index.html |
| Multiblock | 动态多方块系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/multiblock/index.html |
| Registrum | 简化的注册系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/registrum/index.html |
| Util | 可共享的工具方法 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/util/index.html |
| Wheel | 轮盘菜单客户端 API | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/wheel/index.html |
| Rendering | 功能不多的渲染库 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/rendering/index.html |
| Sync | 声明式字段同步系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/sync/index.html |
| Font | 基于 SDF 的字体渲染系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/font/index.html |
| Collision | AABB/三角形 SAT 碰撞检测 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/collision/index.html |
| Space Select | 可视化空间选区系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/space-select/index.html |
| Math | 可序列化的数学表达式系统 | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/math/index.html |
| Main | 聚合模块（包含全部子模块） | https://lib.anvilcraft.dev/posts/docs/main/index.html |
